incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A large, dark cloud formation dominates the sky above a rural landscape with trees, fields, and houses.

observations.description: Large, dark, turbulent cloud mass occupying the upper portion of the frame.
Dark line of coniferous trees and some deciduous trees visible along the horizon.
Residential houses visible on the right side of the image.
Large, dense plume of dark smoke rising from the left, with a lighter, less dense plume on the right.
